summary: Phase 11F Advanced Invoice Layout Reconstruction & Zero-Fragmentation Table Fix forensic engineering report. Details root causes of invoice layout breakdown (naive two-column page splitting, table fragmentation from multi-line descriptions, spacer margin bloat), the architectural solution (vertical semantic zone banding, unified 7-column grid reconstruction with multi-line cell containment, side-by-side party cards, and two distinct reconstruction modes Mode A and Mode B), automated verification results (29/29 PASS across GST invoices, multi-column tables, and banking ledgers), and remaining limitations.
